title: Omaveloxolone ameliorates cognitive dysfunction in APP/PS1 mice by stabilizing the STAT3 pathway.
authors: Cui, Xiaolin; Zong, Shuai; Song, Wenao; Wang, Cuicui; Liu, Yingchao; Zhang, Li; Xia, Pengcheng; Wang, Xueying; Zhao, Hao; Wang, Le; Lu, Zhiming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Omaveloxolone通过STAT3通路改善AD小鼠认知功能，虽含分子对接和转录因子预测，但核心是药物机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: AIMS: To determine the availability and the potential molecular mechanisms underlying the therapeutic effect of omaveloxolone (RTA408) on Alzheimer's Disease (AD). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study employed network pharmacology to assess the feasibility of drug treatment of AD. To determine the cognitive status and emotional state of APPswe/PS1dE9 (APP/PS1) mice after the RTA408 treatment, three classical behavioral experiments (water maze, Y-maze, and open field test) were conducted. Immunofluorescence and immunohistochemical staining were utilized to evaluate hippocampal neuronal status and amyloid (Abeta) deposition in mice. RNA-seq and transcription factor prediction analyses were performed to explore the potential molecular mechanisms regulating the therapeutic effects of RTA408. Molecular docking was employed to predict the direct drug targets. To validate these molecular mechanisms, quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blotting, and immunofluorescence analyses were performed in two instrumental cell lines, i.e., mouse hippocampal neuronal cells (HT22) and microglia (BV2). RESULTS: RTA408 was revealed with the capability to reduce Abeta plaque deposition and to restore damaged neurons in the hippocampal region of APP/PS1 mice, ultimately leading to an improvement in cognitive function. This beneficial effect was achieved by balancing the STAT3 pathway. Specifically, RTA408 facilitated the activations of both STAT3/OXR1 and NRF2/ARE axes, thereby enhancing the compromised resistance in neurons to oxidative stress. RTA408 inhibited the NFkappaB/IL6/STAT3 pathway, effectively countering the neuroinflammation triggered by microglial activation. CONCLUSION: RTA408 is revealed with promising potential in the treatment of AD based on preclinical data.
abstract_zh: 目的：确定奥马沃洛酮（RTA408）对阿尔茨海默病（AD）治疗效果的可用性及潜在分子机制。材料与方法：本研究采用网络药理学评估药物治疗AD的可行性。为确定RTA408处理后APPswe/PS1dE9（APP/PS1）小鼠的认知状态和情绪状态，进行了三项经典行为学实验（水迷宫、Y迷宫和旷场实验）。利用免疫荧光和免疫组织化学染色评估小鼠海马神经元状态及淀粉样蛋白（Abeta）沉积。进行RNA-seq和转录因子预测分析，以探索调控RTA408治疗效果的潜在分子机制。采用分子对接预测直接药物靶点。为验证这些分子机制，在两种工具细胞系，即小鼠海马神经元细胞（HT22）和小胶质细胞（BV2）中进行了定量逆转录PCR（qRT-PCR）、Western blotting和免疫荧光分析。结果：RTA408被揭示具有减少APP/PS1小鼠海马区域Abeta斑块沉积和恢复受损神经元的能力，最终导致认知功能改善。这一有益效果通过平衡STAT3通路实现。具体而言，RTA408促进了STAT3/OXR1和NRF2/ARE轴的激活，从而增强了神经元对氧化应激的受损抵抗力。RTA408抑制了NFkappaB/IL6/STAT3通路，有效对抗了小胶质细胞激活引发的神经炎症。结论：基于临床前数据，RTA408在AD治疗中显示出有前景的潜力。
